meta.source: hub/ui/src/index.css (app tokens, 2026-10-22) plus the brand colours chosen in identity rounds 1-4

tokens.name: madder
tokens.usage: Brand. The thread of the loop logo, and brand surfaces (README, docs headers, slides). Never a button, badge or state: it sits between error red and Claude's terracotta. Mark contrast 4.2:1 on bg (dark), 5.8:1 (light).

tokens.name: verdigris
tokens.usage: The app's one accent hue. Reached through ring and rail-marker only. 8.1:1 on bg (dark), 6.0:1 (light).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, selection. Solid, at least 3:1 on every surface. Replaces the former indigo #7c8cff / #5063d8.

tokens.name: rail-marker
tokens.usage: The active row's marker in the sidebar rail.

tokens.name: ink-tile
tokens.usage: Ground of the app icon and favicon tile, in both themes. Carries the madder thread (dark value).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The one ground plane of the app.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Sidebar rail ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Things that lift: menus, popovers, dialogs, composer, content cards. Not for marking a region.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Second lift; tints derive from it.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Third lift: keyboard hints, pressed fills.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default hairline.

tokens.name: border-hi
tokens.usage: Control outlines.

tokens.name: border-region
tokens.usage: Region separation, deliberately lighter than any control outline.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, rail and every surface.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg and surfaces.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Third level. Holds 3:1 (large text and non-text UI), not 4.5:1, on purpose so the three-level ramp survives (charcoal refresh task 8.11). Not for body copy.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Monochrome emphasis: the primary button fill. The accent hue never fills a control.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on primary.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions only.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Success and the live-connection dot. Always beside a word or icon, never hue alone.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Needs you, waiting, reconnecting.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Informational status.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Session chips.

tokens.name: provider-claude
tokens.usage: Anthropic's published mark colour, for Claude's brand mark only. Mode-independent.

tokens.name: agent-1
tokens.usage: Agent identity, by registration order.

tokens.name: agent-2
tokens.usage: Agent identity. Magenta, changed from teal (#2fd4c8 / #0f9c92) so no agent looks like the verdigris accent.

tokens.name: agent-3
tokens.usage: Agent identity.

tokens.name: agent-4
tokens.usage: Agent identity.

tokens.name: agent-5
tokens.usage: Agent identity.

tokens.name: agent-6
tokens.usage: Agent identity.

tokens.name: agent-7
tokens.usage: Agent identity.

tokens.name: agent-8
tokens.usage: Agent identity.

families.sans: "DM Sans", "DM Sans Variable", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Nothing appears out of thin air.
styles.usage: README and docs heroes, slides. Not used inside the app.

styles.name: tagline
styles.sample: Run your AI factory in the open.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name beside the loop in the app's sidebar head.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The turn that asked has ended.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Keyboard hints, ids in copy actions, code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls (radius - 4px).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, buttons (radius - 2px).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The base radius: cards, panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, large surfaces (radius + 4px).

tokens.name: radius-content
tokens.usage: Self-contained results, markedly softer than chrome.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: The app icon and favicon tile corner: 14 on a 64 grid.
